script:
control-agent-server restart
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/fork" --json "{\"id\": \"$FE\"}" --expect 409 \
  --check detail eq "Conversation with id $FE already exists" --save F10.restart-persist/taken-by-unloaded
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$FN" --quiet --check forked_from_conversation_id eq "$S" \
  --check title eq 'QA F10 named fork' --check tags.qa eq f10 --check execution_status eq idle --save F10.restart-persist/named-fork
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$FE" --quiet --check forked_from_event_id eq "$E1" --check leaf_event_id eq "$E1"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$FW/events/count" --query body=QA_F10_ONLY_FORK --check . eq 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S" --quiet --check . contains '"leaf_event_id": null' --save F10.restart-persist/source
control-agent-server state cat base_state.json --conversation "$S" --max-chars 200 --check head_is_empty eq true
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/events" --json '{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "QA_F10_ROOT2"}], "run": false}' --expect 200 --quiet
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/events/search" --query kind=$MSG --query body=QA_F10_ROOT2 --check items.0.parent_id eq __root__
control-agent-server doctor
